title: Predictions file - Task 3 (proposed default)
description: Default submission layout until Q-01 is answered (02 §6.3, 03 §2.5). feedback must contain at least one non-whitespace character and no control character other than LF (03 §2.5, FR-T3-01). Level compliance is checked by GRD before writing, not by this schema.
x-validator-only: UTF-8 without BOM, valid JSON (FR-VAL-01, FR-VAL-04)
set of sample_id == input ids of the split; no missing, no extra, no duplicate (FR-VAL-01)
feedback is NFC and detected as Vietnamese (FR-T3-01)

sample_id.description: No pattern on purpose: the EX..-S... shape is only observed on 32 samples [GT] and must not block a private file; the id set is checked against the input ids (validator rule 4, 06 §5).
